'''Master Chief''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] and [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]] were given this rank as they trained [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TCW:CC" />
